items.title: 67802_Charles Mingus oral history interview
items.q: Interviewer mentions Gunther (Schweller) in the context of the Lennox Inn school; Interviewee does not mention Gunther or describe a personal relationship.

ctx.x: If they have some whisky, they bring it in. That's not the same as a guy (unintelligible) the beer.

Yeah, yeah, yeah. You mentioned before -- Ornette reminded me, that school of jazz they had was Lennox Inn, in the Berkshires, where -- John Lewis was teaching there and Gunther (Schweller) and all that. And it seemed to generate some excitment and then disappeared. Do you think that's feasible, someday having -- like, they have the Manhatten School of Music, the Juilliard or Rochester, having a really first class school of jazz? Can it be -- it's the old cliche question, can it be taught?
Well, it's being taught to the white guys.
